name: anything2explainer
title_zh: 黑底星点幕布上的代码动画科普片，配音字幕进度条一次成
tagline_zh: 手上有主题却卡在分镜、配音、字幕、进度条四道工序上？它把 Remotion 图元库、TTS。
tagline_en: Stuck on storyboard, voiceover, subtitles and progress bar? Get a Remotion primitive library, TTS, chapter bar.
desc_en: 给一个主题，产出一条黑底 MG 风格（幕底可选星点或点阵波）、有配音字幕章节进度条的科普讲解视频（中文或英文；Remotion 代码动画；时长由用户定，常用 3–5 分钟）。内含可编译模板、图元库、配音/分镜/渲染工具、风格与动效规范、多 agent 分工协议与 QC 判据，以及一条完整样片（《RAG 与知识库》）作为质量标尺。Turn any topic into a narrated motion-graphics explainer video in Chinese or English, on a black canvas with a star-field or dot-field backdrop, TTS voiceover, subtitles and a chapter progress bar, every frame drawn in code with Remoti
why_zh: 每一帧都是代码画的，不是套模板；风格与动效规范写死，多 agent 分工协议让分镜、配音。
why_en: Every frame is drawn in code, not templated. Style and motion specs are fixed, a multi-agent protocol splits storyboard, voice.
limit_zh: 只出黑底 MG 一种视觉，星点或点阵波二选一，想要白底、真人出镜或实拍素材就别装。
limit_en: Black-canvas MG only, star-field or dot-field, no white background, live action or stock footage. Needs Node and Remotion locally plus an external.
title_en: Code-animated explainer videos on a black star-field canvas
